taiwan-legal-db.title: Taiwan Legal Database
taiwan-legal-db.description: Stdio MCP server exposing fifteen read-only tools over Taiwan's judicial judgment portal (judgment.judicial.gov.tw), National Regulation Database (law.moj.gov.tw), Constitutional Court records (cons.judicial.gov.tw), the Judicial Yuan law database (legal.judicial.gov.tw), ministries' official interpretation systems, Executive Yuan appeal and Fair Trade Commission decisions, and the Legislative Yuan law system (lis.ly.gov.tw). Source: github.com/lawchat-oss/mcp-taiwan-legal-db.
